title: HM Land Registry official public-source register
scope: Discovery metadata for authoritative and official-reference HM Land Registry sources. This register does not contain property records, legal advice, service responses, credentials, signed download URLs, page bodies, or attachments.
jurisdiction_note: HM Land Registry registers the ownership of land and property in England and Wales. UK-wide statistical products and cross-government catalogues state their own coverage.
authority_precedence: Current legislation and formal notices control legal requirements.
Current publisher-operated HM Land Registry pages, terms and developer packs control operational use.
GOV.UK and other official discovery catalogues provide discovery metadata and can lag a publisher source.
This bundle is an independent discovery aid and is never an authority for ownership, boundaries, priority, fees, service status or legal interpretation.

public_metadata_lanes: GOV.UK Search API records attributed to organisation slug land-registry
Bounded GOV.UK Content API locale and available-translations observations for already-enumerated routes
Public repository metadata for the LandRegistry GitHub organisation
CDDO API Catalogue rows whose provider is hm-land-registry

rights_states.open-with-conditions: Public metadata or data is reusable only under the source-specific licence, attribution and third-party-rights conditions.
rights_states.bespoke-or-paid: Access or reuse is governed by a bespoke, direct-use, exploration or commercial licence and may involve a fee.
rights_states.restricted-service: The public description is discoverable, but the operational service requires authentication, approval, payment or compliance with service terms.
rights_states.metadata-only: Only public discovery metadata is represented; no inference is made about rights in linked content, code, data or attachments.

source_families.title: GOV.UK Search API — HM Land Registry organisation filter
source_families.acquisition: Bounded paginated JSON metadata census. No page bodies or attachments.
source_families.refresh: Take a new dated snapshot for each release.
caveats: Organisation attribution does not establish that a result is current guidance.
Search publication dates are not dataset currency dates.
The denominator changes as GOV.UK content changes.

source_families.title: GOV.UK Content API
source_families.acquisition: Bounded locale and available-translations metadata observation for already-enumerated GOV.UK routes. Bodies, contacts, details and attachments are excluded.
source_families.refresh: Refresh only the bounded observation set when its declared freshness rule requires it.
caveats: This is not an independent content denominator.
Locale is taken from the Content API; no unsupported locale parameter is sent to the Search API.
Rendered bodies and attachments remain outside bundle scope.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry on GOV.UK
source_families.acquisition: Curated metadata plus the exhaustive GOV.UK Search lane.
source_families.refresh: Observe organisation, collections, services and policy routes at each release.
caveats: GOV.UK collections overlap with search results.
Open Government Licence coverage has exceptions and does not erase third-party rights.

source_families.title: Use land and property data catalogue
source_families.acquisition: Curated catalogue and technical metadata only; no bulk data download.
source_families.refresh: Reconcile the publisher catalogue at each release.
caveats: Licence, price, authentication, cadence and file size vary by dataset.
A public landing page does not grant redistribution rights.
Some products are multi-gigabyte and need specialist software.

source_families.title: Use land and property data API v1
source_families.acquisition: Documentation metadata only; the API is never called by this bundle.
source_families.refresh: Observe public API documentation at each release.
caveats: An account, accepted dataset licence and API key are required.
Signed resource URLs are short-lived credentials and must never be published.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry linked data
source_families.acquisition: Service and documentation metadata only; no unbounded SPARQL or resource crawl.
source_families.refresh: Check service and documentation routes at each release.
caveats: Price Paid Data and UK House Price Index linked-data models have different semantics.
A query endpoint does not itself establish a right to perform unbounded extraction.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry Business Gateway developer pack
source_families.acquisition: Documentation, schema and contract metadata only; no test or production calls.
source_families.refresh: Pin the documentation commit used by each release.
caveats: Most operational services require Business e-services approval and certificate-based access.
SOAP/WSDL and REST products must remain distinct.
Publisher documentation outranks a discovery catalogue for current operation.

source_families.title: LandRegistry GitHub organisation
source_families.acquisition: Bounded public repository metadata through the unauthenticated GitHub REST API.
source_families.refresh: Snapshot public repository metadata at each release.
caveats: Every repository has its own lifecycle and licence.
Public source code is not necessarily production documentation.
Archived, fork and prototype status must remain visible.

source_families.title: Search for land and property information
source_families.acquisition: Public service-description metadata only; no account creation, search or purchase.
source_families.refresh: Observe public guidance, fees and terms at each release.
caveats: Downloaded copies are not proof of ownership and differ from official copies.
Title plans normally show general boundaries, not exact legal boundaries.

source_families.title: Search for local land charges
source_families.acquisition: Terms and public service-description metadata only; never automate a search.
source_families.refresh: Observe coverage, fees and terms at each release.
caveats: Terms prohibit automated software agents from searching, copying or monitoring the service.
Coverage depends on local-authority migration.
CON29 enquiries are outside the service.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry portal and Business e-services
source_families.acquisition: Public guidance metadata only; no portal authentication or transaction.
source_families.refresh: Observe public guidance, roadmap and service notices at each release.
caveats: Access is intended for approved professional customers.
Availability, fees and transaction coverage can change.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry customer help
source_families.acquisition: Top-level help and contact-route metadata only.
source_families.refresh: Observe support routes at each release.
caveats: Public forum posts and uploads are excluded because they may contain personal or sensitive information.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry blog
source_families.acquisition: Index metadata only in this scaffold; no article-body crawl.
source_families.refresh: Consider a bounded feed snapshot in a later release.
caveats: Blog posts provide context but do not replace current formal guidance.

source_families.title: HM Land Registry fee calculator
source_families.acquisition: Minimal public title, description and route metadata only; no calculation, submission or result capture.
source_families.refresh: Recheck the public route and specialist rights decision for each candidate.
caveats: Public access to the calculator does not authorise reuse of its operation, generated estimates or results.
Calculator output is not a substitute for the current Fee Order and official guidance.

source_families.title: Legislation.gov.uk land-registration legislation
source_families.acquisition: Curated legislation identity and source-route metadata only; no page-body or attachment acquisition.
source_families.refresh: Recheck the exact legislation routes, revision status and official reuse terms for each candidate.
caveats: Legislation.gov.uk content is available under the Open Government Licence v3.0 except where otherwise stated.
Original, revised and prospective text must remain distinct, and legislation is not legal advice.

source_families.title: CDDO API Catalogue
source_families.acquisition: Bounded CSV scan filtered exactly to provider hm-land-registry.
source_families.refresh: Snapshot from an identified catalogue revision at each release.
caveats: Catalogue rows may lag publisher-operated documentation.
Licence and authentication fields can be absent.

Rows whose canonical endpoint host is businessgateway.landregistry.gov.uk inherit RIGHT-RESTRICTED and approved-professional-user access; CDDO catalogue publication never makes the service public or anonymous.
An older sibling-bundle seed contained 27 HMLR records; the frozen live provider-filtered snapshot returned 15.

source_families.title: National Data Library and data.gov.uk discovery records
source_families.owner: Government Digital Service and National Data Library programme
source_families.acquisition: Curated discovery references only in the initial scaffold.
source_families.refresh: Reconcile publisher records before claiming catalogue completeness.
caveats: Catalogue metadata can be stale even when a linked publisher distribution is current.
Publisher landing pages control cadence, access and current operational status.
